description_en: Retrieves the basic information about tables in a data lake
description_zh: 调用此API可以获取数据湖中表的基本信息
kebab_example: aliyun dms list-data-lake-tablebase-info --rows 10 --page 1 --search-key test --db-name default --catalog-name hive --tid 30000 --workspace-id 120000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDataLakeTablebaseInfo

parameters.help_en: The number of rows on each page for a paged query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数
parameters.name: rows

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list for a paged query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时列表的页码
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The keyword used to search for table names
parameters.name: search_key

parameters.help_en: The name of the database where the table is located
parameters.help_zh: 表所在的数据库的名称
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the data catalog
parameters.name: catalog_name

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. Call the GetUserActiveTenant operation to get the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口GetUserActiveTenant获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid
